page.title: Requests
page.description: The company's requests; child requests sit under their root request.

new.title: New request
new.description: The project's Assistant takes the request, splits the work and hands it to the agents.
new.noReadyProject: No project is ready yet. Finish adding a project or fix the failing checks on the Project page.
new.researchMissing: The company has no “research” label, so the Research type is unavailable.
new.titlePlaceholder: What needs doing, in one sentence
new.noRoles: This project has no Crew role table yet, so the Assistant is unknown. Set roles on the Project page and try again.

comments.heading: Comments
comments.liveFailed: Could not load the run output

composer.label: Write a comment
composer.placeholder: Write a comment (markdown). Paste an image or file to attach it.

attachments.heading: Attachments
attachments.deleteBody: File {{name}} will be removed from the request. This cannot be undone.

runs.heading: Runs of this request
runs.stopBody: Run {{id}} will be stopped and its process on the work machine ends. The agent may have to redo unfinished work.

gate.stale: The request has changed and you are no longer the approver of this stage. The page has been reloaded.

approve.title: Approve this request?
approve.body: The owner approval stage completes and the workflow hands over to the integrator to push.
approve.label: Approval note
approve.hint: Required. The note is saved as the decision comment.

requestChanges.title: Request changes
requestChanges.body: Work goes back to the previous worker and counts as one more fix round.
requestChanges.label: What needs fixing

cancel.title: Cancel this request?
cancel.body: The request becomes Cancelled and any run on the machine is stopped. You can reopen it later.

reopen.title: Reopen this request?
reopen.body: The request goes back to To do and every stage runs again in a new round.

crew.mapFailed: Could not load the Crew summary
crew.docsFailed: Could not load the docs check

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.failed: Could not load the runtime decisions

interactions.loadFailed: Could not load the assistant questions

forceDone.title: Force this request to Done?
forceDone.body: The request goes straight to Done, skipping any gates not yet passed. It does not count as an approval and starts no new review round.
forceDone.noGates: The request has no pending workflow stage.
forceDone.runs_one: {{count}} running run of this request will be stopped.
forceDone.runs_other: {{count}} running runs of this request will be stopped.
forceDone.grandchildren: Only the sub-tasks listed here are cancelled. Their own sub-tasks, and sub-tasks created after this dialog opened, are left as they are.
forceDone.reasonHint: Required, {{min}}–{{max}} characters. The reason is posted as a comment and kept in History.
forceDone.stale: The request just changed status ({{status}}); nothing was sent. The page has been reloaded.
forceDone.warnings: Forced to Done, but some follow-ups failed
forceDone.childFailures_one: Forced to Done, but {{count}} sub-task could not be cancelled
forceDone.childFailures_other: Forced to Done, but {{count}} sub-tasks could not be cancelled

warning.comment_failed: the reason comment was not posted
warning.wakeup_failed: the assistant on the parent request was not notified
warning.activity_failed: the History entry was not written
warning.violations_unread: the list of skipped gates could not be read

action.docsUninitialized: Repo has no docs setup; docs gate passed

violation.docs_stale: docs check older than the latest change
violation.push_stale: push older than the owner's approval
violation.push_sha_mismatch: pushed commit differs from the docs-checked commit
